race.comment: UTAH (7) gets the nod after producing the right response as favourite in a BM54 at this track, picking up strongly to beat Outcaster by a head. The rise to BM68 is genuine, but he drops in weight, has the winning rider back and brings the best recent profile. CHARLESFORT (8) is the main danger, especially coming back from Saturday company at Morphettville where he was beaten just under five lengths in a BM62. His prior BM56 win at this track came at the expense of UTAH, and his 1750m record gives him a solid platform. DIVINE FIRE (9) has to rebound from a plain last at this venue, but the Bordertown BM58 second two runs ago and her two wins at this distance keep her right in calculations. THERE GOES MY HERO (3) has been honest, placed last start and coming through a BM64 run two back, though his 1750m record leaves him more of a measured winning hope than a standout. MY MATE SONNY (1) can feature again stepping up in distance.
